decisionContext: The owner explicitly approved both 24-row North Node source batches on 2026-09-05 and then authorized shipping the 48 approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus by replying "yes please continue".
summary: An old pattern can become especially attractive when the alternative requires more change than you expected to make at once.
body: An old pattern can become especially attractive when the alternative requires more change than you expected to make at once. When Uranus opposes the North Node, the known schedule, old system, former group, or previous way of doing things can look safer after a sudden change leaves you disoriented. Familiarity may buy useful time, especially while you replace what disappeared. Just make sure the temporary retreat helps you rebuild your options instead of restoring the exact restriction that made change necessary.
